_status: FINAL target map (freeze #2 input). Hand-reviewed by the coordinator against discriminator_ids.json (153 ids) and the 36 frozen cases; supersedes benchmark/target_map.PROPOSED.json.
_rule: DECISIONS #13 / #18(5): each target maps to a SET of record ids and is present if ANY mapped id is on the card. Ids were kept only when the record's maneuver/question IS the target or a same-construct component of it; merely related ids were excluded. record_ids == [] means no record in the id list satisfies the target (library-coverage gap; listed under _unmapped).
